summary: Ravalli County, MT 20-ft pole L-4 tower dated 1933; its cab moved to Antrim Point around 1940; site listed gone, and no source describes it today.

facts.status_note: firelookout.com lists the site as gone; the cab was moved to Antrim Point; no source describes the site today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates the tower to 1933. The Forest Lookouts Montana page quotes a May 1931 Ravalli Republican item about a 20-foot lookout on Kress Point, not Dutch Hill, and does not tie it to this site. The story mentions the item without treating it as the same station.

The Dutch Hill record and the Forest Lookouts Montana page give 1940 for the cab move; the firelookout.com Antrim page says Antrim was established in 1939 with that cab; the Forest Lookouts Antrim page dates the Antrim site to 1937.
The firelookout.com Antrim page implies 1973 (five years after 1968); the Forest Lookouts Antrim page says the lookout duties moved in 1973; the register gives 1974.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources (tower, Bitterroot NF, gone); no corrections. No staffing names for Dutch Hill itself in any source read. The Kress Point newspaper item may describe a different station; the story does not assume it does. Fate of the original L-4 cab after its 1968 replacement is not described in the sources, so the story omits it. The Antrim Point index entry (Gone) was not used. No photos gathered.
